hook: *Rs 50* tap aerators cut water use 40% in a Cyberabad community
hook_b: *Rs 50* tap aerators cut water use 40% in a Cyberabad community
tldr: Experts and the Indian Green Building Council are pushing tap aerators, small Rs 50-70 devices that mix air into tap water, as Hyderabad faces water-supply concerns.

beats.what: RWAs in Kondapur and Gachibowli have started handing out aerators; one community is fitting them across all 500 flats, three to four per home.
beats.why: Water from Singur and Manjeera is under pressure and HMWSSB has asked households to voluntarily cut use by at least 20%.
beats.care: A water-board tanker costs around Rs 500 and a private one Rs 3,000-4,000, so saving at the tap can delay that booking.
